name: Calnode
description: Calnode is a Calendly-style booking app — with first-party video meetings, recording, and AI notetaking built in. It's API-first, webhook-native, and built for a world where agents do the booking. Nothing is paywalled.
seoDescription: Scheduling and booking tool, an alternative to Calendly. Self-host Calnode on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
